_note: Tủ đồ catalogue. Edit here, then run python3 scripts/build_prompts.py (prompt files) or python3 scripts/gen_closet.py (GPT images). Template: docs/PROMPT-RULES-TEAM.md §7. status: idea | need | blocked | gen | approved

head.label: Đầu (neo đầu)
head.fit: Straight front view, exactly as it sits on top of a big round head between two round ears; leave clear gaps or cut-outs where the two ears poke through. About as wide as the head.

neck.label: Cổ (neo cổ)
neck.en: worn around the neck and chest
neck.fit: Straight front view, exactly as it wraps a short chubby neck just under a big round head; the top edge is a gentle smile-shaped curve, the rest hangs on the chest.

back.label: Lưng (cần neo lưng, chưa có trong brief)
back.fit: Straight front view of the item as it sits BEHIND the character: draw the whole item, symmetrical, straps or ties pointing toward the centre; the app hides the middle behind the body so only the sides peek out.

hand.label: Tay cầm (cần neo tay, chưa có trong brief)
hand.fit: Held upright as if in a small mitten paw: the handle or grip is at the bottom-centre, the item stands straight up, small enough to be held in one paw.

body.label: Thân (cần neo thân, chưa có trong brief)
body.fit: Straight front view of a tiny garment for a chubby round body with short arms, laid flat and symmetrical, short sleeves, no body inside.

food.label: Món khoái khẩu (icon + cho ăn)
food.fit: A single serving seen in three-quarter view from slightly above, small enough to be held in two paws.

streak.label: Giữ chuỗi (icon)
streak.fit: A single object seen straight on, chunky and simple, works as an icon.

tiers.80: Phụ kiện thường, món mới mỗi đợt
